subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should the built-in `write` tool expose `append?: boolean` as the permanent model-facing append contract, or should OpenClaw use a `mode` field or a separate append tool instead?
rationale: The linked issue and source review establish the need for an append primitive, but the exact tool API is a compatibility-sensitive product decision for agent behavior and persisted memory/session files.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
options.body: Land this PR or an equivalent exact-head branch if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

options.title: Require a `mode` contract
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit write mode if maintainers want a more extensible tool schema before merge.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Keep `write` overwrite-only and request a dedicated append tool if maintainers want operation separation over schema growth.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
recommendation.body: Land this PR or an equivalent exact-head branch if maintainers want the smallest backwards-compatible extension to the existing write tool.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best available routing owner for the agent runtime/tool API product boundary based on recent agent-runtime history.
